metadata.description: A corrupting poison debuff that clings to a humanoid target: an acid-green impact splash spreads over the body into clinging toxic vapour, glowing sludge drips, rising bubbles and corroding surface patches.
metadata.analysis: hit 0-0.2: green flash and droplet burst at chest height, arriving from the camera side | spread 0.2-0.6: the emission ellipsoid's scale grows from a chest patch to the whole body so splashes run outward over the target | envelop 0.6-1.0: the raymarched gas volumes bloom and licks wrap the body | active 1.0-2.8: full loop - swirling vapours, drips falling and splashing on the ground, bubbles rising and popping, flickering corrosion patches, green point light | linger 2.8-3.5: rates and density thin out | fade 3.5-4.0: everything falls to zero
metadata.timing: hit 0-0.2, spread 0.2-0.6, envelop 0.6-1.0, active 1.0-2.8 (loopable), linger 2.8-3.5, fade 3.5-4.0

target_volume.note: The effect wraps this invisible volume; attach it to the character's root in the game.
